purpose: Fresh Gate 3 tranche E player-language benchmark for terse ordinary table questions, authored only after r15 and semantic-v2 were merged.
blindnessPolicy: Do not edit or retroactively regrade this tranche after its first paid live run; preserve that run as immutable blind evidence.
Any failed tranche-E case may become a regression after diagnosis, but it may not be reused as evidence of a later blind pass.
If candidate behavior changes after tranche E, certify the changed behavior with a newly authored blind tranche.
Do not exactly reuse prior Gate 2 or Gate 3 A/B/C/D questions.

cases.question: used onward, ran into them. do i still get the extra step after fight?

semanticCriteria.statement: When Onward movement enters the opponent's Position and initiates a battle, that movement sequence ends; there is no leftover Onward movement to use after the battle.

cases.question: im at 2 command, win first fight, spend one later. do i get the missed command then?

semanticCriteria.statement: The first win still counts as the turn's normal Command trigger even while already at the 2 Command maximum, so a later win does not generate a delayed replacement Command.

cases.question: they accepted my terms. do we still do aftermath stuff?

semanticCriteria.statement: Accepted Terms end the sequence during Onset, so no Aftermath is resolved.

cases.question: stake is 2. can i spend that on leverage too?

semanticCriteria.statement: Staked Influence cannot be spent on Leverage.

cases.question: treasury 5, i control 3 after capture. can i act opening and denouement?

semanticCriteria.statement: Because Treasury value exceeds controlled Territories at the Financial Capacity check, the Financier may take one Action in Opening and one in Denouement that turn, provided at least one is a Financier Faction Feature marked 1 Action.

cases.question: started the mission this turn and its already done. can i finish it now?

semanticCriteria.statement: A Mission cannot complete during the turn it begins even if its requirement is already satisfied.

cases.question: they stopped my surveillance. do i get the intel back?

semanticCriteria.statement: If Surveillance is prevented, the Intel remains spent.

cases.question: two rites complete. what value arcane do guardians need?

semanticCriteria.statement: With two completed Rites, Guardians of the Circle requires an Arcane card from Hand with value at least 3.

cases.question: already transmuted this turn. second battle, can i do it again?

semanticCriteria.statement: Transmutation is once per turn, so it cannot be used again in a second battle that same turn.

cases.question: three of their cards hit graveyard in one aftermath. thats 3 conviction right?

semanticCriteria.statement: Several qualifying opposing cards entering the Graveyard in the same battle's Aftermath produce only 1 normal Conviction gain.

cases.question: final judgment on a 1 conviction purge makes it free?

semanticCriteria.statement: Final Judgment's cost reduction has a minimum of 1, so a 1-Conviction Purge does not become free.

cases.question: i beat their attack but already used pursuit this turn. pursuit again?

semanticCriteria.statement: Relentless Pursuit is limited to once per turn, so it cannot be used again that turn.

cases.question: line of credit on a 5 cost deed, 4 value collateral. how much capital left to pay?

semanticCriteria.statement: For a 5-Capital purchase, Line of Credit can make the collateral contribute at most 2, leaving 3 Capital to pay.

cases.question: mission control can start a special op?

semanticCriteria.statement: Mission Control can start another eligible normal Mission, not a Special Operation.

cases.question: im past two enemy lands at capture. i take both?

semanticCriteria.statement: Normal Capture advances the Front Line by at most one Territory per turn, even if the token is beyond two enemy Territories.

cases.question: tiebreak roll tied again. roll again?

semanticCriteria.statement: A tied Tiebreak Roll is rerolled.

cases.question: reembodiment is banked and i transmute an arcane from hand. can it pull a lower card back?

semanticCriteria.statement: If the Arcane card from Hand is the first qualifying Reembodiment event that turn, using it for Transmutation can let Reembodiment return one other lower-value card from Graveyard to Hand after Transmutation resolves.

cases.question: they use necromancy to pull cards out of grave. can anathema keep them there?

semanticCriteria.statement: Anathema may be discarded when the opponent's Necromancy would move cards from their Graveyard to another zone, causing those cards to remain in the Graveyard.
